answer: Quadratic identity bonding at the marble registry: each additional Sybil identity costs n² tokens to bond. A plume of linked registrations is detected when marginal cost outpaces any plausible reward. Shale-hard slashing burns the full bond of every identity in a flagged cluster. An attacker bonding 10 identities pays 385 units versus 55 for honest single registration, so break-even arrives before identity #8.
